_readme: Meli wood palette — read on every request by app-v2/studio/meli.py (no restart needed).

Each colour: id (a-z, 0-9, dashes — also the reference file name), name_pl, optional opacity (coverage level 10 transparent oil / 30 stain / 55 semi-opaque lasur / 80 opaque paint / 100 full lacquer — leave it out to follow the finish photographs), optional finish ('stain'|'opaque', the fallback when there is neither opacity nor photographs), optional hex '#RRGGBB', optional prompt_en (short English description of the tone), optional group (picker heading).
Finish photographs: app-v2/meli/references/<id>.jpg, <id>-2.jpg, <id>-3.jpg … (JPEG ≤ 2048 px). Up to 4 per colour are sent to the model.
